name: Avid Reader (Rite Publishing)
body:
You have a passion for reading, and can quickly digest written information.

Benefit: The first time each day you prepare spells or extracts from a spellbook or formula book, preparing those spells or extracts takes half the normal amount of time.

Convergent Paths: Students of Arcanum Archetypes Copyright 2013 Steven D. Russell; Author: Eric Morton
